limitations: This is a prose excerpt corpus, not a complete digital reproduction of the chapters.
Questions that require diagrams, numerical tables, calculations or omitted formulas may have insufficient evidence.
Historical examples and figures retain the source's 2018 context and are not current economic facts.
PDF and printed page numbering differ by 10 pages in these sections.
